card_text: Induction cooktops and infrared cookers repaired in-house at the shop.
title: Induction and infrared cooker repair in Bhaktapur
intro: We repair induction cooktops and infrared cookers in-house at our shop in Sukuldhoka, Bhaktapur. Bring the cooker to the shop and we'll check it.
how: Bring the cooker to the shop in Sukuldhoka.
We check it and tell you the price before any work starts.
ask: Hi, induction/infrared cooker repair bare sodhnu chha.
